Meet Our Founder & Artistic Director

Leading the show with precision.

Alaimithun
Founder & Choreographer, Step N Style Dance Crew

With years of professional experience on major entertainment stages across Mumbai, Alaimithun leads an elite troupe of dancers specializing in concept-driven corporate entertainment and production choreography.

From winning major dance competitions like DHL Champions 2025 and Orlem Youth Week 2022 to designing high-concept prop acts and fashion ramp walks, Alaimithun brings disciplined precision and showstopping energy to every production.

Services

Entertainment with impact.

Concept-driven performances across corporate events, fashion, weddings and large-format productions.

01

Fashion Show Choreography

Ramp entries, model positioning, high-fashion movement direction and thematic music integration.

Signature Acts

Stories that own the stage.

Warrior & Prop Show

A dramatic signature act featuring metallic shields, swords and intricate prop armor, paired with the Sun Prop Costume Act for a majestic atmosphere.

✦ Corporate Openers — designed for high-profile stage entrances.
✦ Product Unveils — cinematic choreography with visual impact.

Mythological & Peacock Theme

Traditional Indian mythology, vibrant peacock props and LED stage backdrops combine into an ethereal cultural spectacle.

✦ Cultural expos and international delegate welcome galas.
✦ Grand wedding sangeets seeking heritage with modern production.

Group Fusion & Pyramids

Indo-Western fusion, contemporary and folk styles with live multi-tier pyramid formations for breathtaking stage climaxes.

The supplied profile notes that these stunts are rigorously rehearsed with safety standards.

ABOUT STEP N STYLE

Dance that makes
events unforgettable.

Step N Style Dance Crew is a Mumbai-based professional dance and production troupe creating high-energy performances for corporate events, weddings, fashion shows, launches and special celebrations.

Built for the stage

Founded and choreographed by Alaimithun, the crew combines powerful choreography, expressive storytelling, visual concepts and disciplined production to create memorable live experiences.

From compact corporate acts to large-scale productions, Step N Style can tailor dancers, themes, costumes, props and choreography to the event.
